digest.component_or_area: plan review verdict emission and workflow failure routing
propositions: A stale or malformed project criteria configuration raises CriteriaError during assemble-criteria, but the generic workflow interpreter records only an undifferentiated string, causing downstream gate dispatch to misclassify it as an LLM unavailability rather than a configuration fault.
The degraded verdict tail unconditionally marks every unrecovered scripted failure as llm_unavailable=true, even when no provider/LLM frame executed and the actual failure is criteria parsing.

Operators receive misleading INDETERMINATE verdicts labeled with llm_unavailable for local configuration mismatches, directing remediation effort toward provider credentials instead of repository checkout or installed-build repair.

The fix must preserve the structured CriteriaError identity from assemble boundary through verdict dispatch, emit a distinct config_fault field without affirmative llm_unavailable, and keep the verdict INDETERMINATE with full deterministic coverage.

Genuine LLM outages (LLMUnavailableError) and healthy provider paths must remain functionally unchanged; only structured CriteriaError from the assemble step is routed through the new config-fault path.
